entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad, Lucknow Bench
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Another
Counsel for Applicant :- Ashish Raman Mishra,Aradhana Chaturvedi
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Shamim Ahmed,J.
In compliance of this Court order dated 9.1.2023 applicant no.1 Tushar Shukla and opposite party
no.2 Shuchi Tiwari are present in person before this Court today.
They are identified by their counsels.

Heard Shri Ashish Raman Mishra, learned Counsel for the applicants, Shailendra Kumar Tripathi alongwith Tapan Verma, learned counsel for opposite party no.-2 and Shri Diwakar Singh, learned AGA for the state and perused the material available on record.

In compliance of this Court's order dated 09-01-2023 joint supplementary affidavit dated 17-01-2023 regarding terms and conditions to settle the dispute, signed by applicant no.1 Tushar Shukla and opposite party no.-2 Smt. Shuchi Tiwari has been filed before this Court today, which is taken on record.

entities.text: Tushar Shukla And Others vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: In para no.-4 of the said joint supplementary affidavit, it has been stated that applicant No.-1- Tushar Shukla is ready to pay amount of Rs. 11,00,000/- (Rs. Eleven Lakhs) to opposite party no.-2 Smt. Shuchi Tiwari as one time alimony .

It was also stated in para No.-5 that out of Rs. 11,00,000/-
as agreed between the parties applicant no.-1-Tushar Shukla to show his bonafide has paid Rs.
2,00,000/- through Cheque bearing no. 000019 dated 17-01-2023 of Bank of India, Branch LDA Colony, CMS Campus, Kanpur Road Lucknow.
A copy of original cheque was given to Shuchi Tiwari through her Advocate Shri Shailendra Kumar Tripathi and the photostat copy of the said cheque is kept on record of this file.

It was further observed that amount of Rs. 25,000/- which was directed to be deposited by applicant no.-1 Tushar Shukla in pursuance of order dated 17-11-2022, is directed to be taken by opposite party no.2 Smt. Shuchi Tiwari from the Senior Registrar, High Court of Judicature at Lucknow Bench, Lucknow.

entities.text: High Court of Judicature at Lucknow Bench, Lucknow
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Thus, it was further agreed between the parties in para no.-5 that remaining amount of Rs. 9,00,000/- (Rs. Nine Lakhs) be paid to opposite party no.-2 Smt. Shuchi Tiwari at the time of passing of decree by the court below under section 13-B of Hindu Marriage Act.

It was further agreed between the parties in para no.-6 that the total items mentioned from serial no. 1 to 7 therein be given by the applicant no.-1 Tushar Shukla to opposite party no.-2 Shuchi Tiwari within one week from today at the house of opposite party no.-2 Shuchi Tiwari, in front of both the counsels.

It was further stated in para nos. 7,8 and 9 that the entire dispute has now been settled between the parties and any case filed by either of the parties be withdrawn after decree passed under section 13-B of Hindu Marriage Act.

It was also prayed before this Court that the entire proceedings of the case- State Vs. Tushar Shukla and others arising out of case crime no.
0451 of 2021, under sections 498A,323,504,506 IPC and section 3/4 Dowry Prohibition Act, Police Station Krishna Nagar, District Lucknow pending in the court of Special Chief Judicial Magistrate (Custom), Lucknow be quashed in terms of the joint supplementary affidavit dated 17-01-2023 filed today before this Court.

entities.text: State Vs. Tushar Shukla and others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

entities.text: Dowry Prohibition Act, Police Station Krishna Nagar, District Lucknow
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text:
Accordingly, in view of the statements made by the respective parties as well as by their counsels and the joint supplementary affidavit filed before this Court, the entire proceedings of the case- State Vs. Tushar Shukla and others arising out of case crime no. 0451 of 2021, under sections 498A,323,504,506 IPC and section 3/4 Dowry Prohibition Act, Police Station Krishna Nagar,
District Lucknow pending in the court of Special Chief Judicial Magistrate (Custom), Lucknow as well as impugned charge-sheet dated 20.01.2022 and impugned summoning order dated 9.3.2022 passed by Special Chief Judicial Magistrate (Custom), Lucknow are quashed.

entities.text: State Vs. Tushar Shukla and others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: It is also directed that the parties will file application under section 13-B of Hindu Marriage Act before court below within 15 days from today and the court below is also directed to expedite the proceedings at the earliest without granting any unnecessary adjournments to either of the parties.
This application is allowed with the observations made above.

It is made clear that in case any conditions of the joint supplementary affidavit dated 17-01-2023 is violated, it is open for either of the parties to move recall application before this Court for recalling this order.
